full_judgment: 10. Mr Shaheed Alam, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner at the time of hearing of the Rule filed a supplementary affidavit annexing certain papers being Annexure-A, B and B1 of which Annexure-A is the attested copy of land acquisition plan (LA Declaration No. 61 dated 8-12-1927 of Shaistagonj to Habiganj Rail line with attested copies of settlement map and settlement Khatian which has been annexed as Annexure-B, together with supplementary affidavit and the Annexure-B1 is attested copy of RS Khatian which stands in the name of Bangladesh Railway.
